title: OutbreakOverrides v1
description: Geographic and art corrections for one OutbreakGeo, kept apart from it and applied by the Roblox builder (from P01). Never gameplay: that is the GameplayLayer. Google Street View is not an allowed basis for any entry.

city.description: The city slug (metadata.source_city.slug of the OutbreakGeo).

geo_sha256.description: The OutbreakGeo file these were written against.

buildings.description: Keyed by OutbreakGeo building id (w123, w123r, w123#2).

facade_archetype.description: A facade kit family the AssetManifest knows (its fits.facade_archetypes).

roof_archetype.description: A roof kit family the AssetManifest knows (its fits.roof_archetypes).

hide.description: Leave the building out (demolished, wrong in OSM).

replace_with.description: AssetManifest id of a special_mesh that stands in for the generated building.

basis.description: Where the correction comes from. osm_correction: OSM itself was (or should be) fixed. art_direction: a choice, not a fact (LOD, archetypes). Street View is deliberately not a value.

source.description: What makes the correction traceable. A basis label alone establishes nothing.

reference.description: site_visit: the visit log entry; own_photo: the photo files; open_data: the dataset, version and URL; osm_correction: the OSM changeset or note; art_direction: the decision record.

by.description: Who made the observation or decision.
